content: Donzide maachchuntsi baz
Cima ne aday fana bonchchop attin kaccippe. Yidhdhuntsana ne ishe fana mahi bo7o.
Maachi Cimuntsana ne inttii fana, wuduruntsana ne mishunts fana, folo geeshshatitsara aykko.
Azinii hyayqqide turii budanuntsana maaddii bonchcho.
Yezin budanttis na7untsi woy na7unts na7a yeziko, yentsi na7unts turii ayyaana yessi yezanno beesade fana yeliduntsanan, fa aftoon mayzayan maaddii kushe mahe tamaaro. Yinna Xooz ufayssize baz.
Fa faas yeze turii budantta Xoozzeppa maade denggodes ufayssara naagane. Awaran qamma Xoozii fana maaddode fana woosara minggane.
Yezin hyanna alamite lo77o yessi xalaala koyze budantta faxa yezara hyayqqidanno.
Oonin unttana boraame fana hyanna timirttito unttis inggo.
Yezin fa iginuntsis, ubbappa aatstsii fa kara asuntsis qoppoosse oonin fa ammantto kaddidaya; ammanoosse asappan aadhii iita.
Bere izipuntam kumikaayze budanttis suntsito mazggabe xaafippe. Mahi yinnilla afa iza fa azinzes ammaninttidanno maaqqodes beezane.
Na7untsana dichchera, zaqqo mokkera, geeshshuntsis tohe meeccera, madhidhide as maaddera, lo77o oocha ubbas fana aatsii inggidannon lo77o oochara erinttidanno maaqqades beezane.
Yezin na7atits maaqqide azinii baayzuntsi suntsito mazggabe xaafippe. Unttana azini gele gelo gaaze asho amo aykkize wode Kiristtoosa ashshoda.
Un tiino gelide qaaltto mentside gisho firddinttoda.
Yinnilla afa un oocha dhabin keetstsappa keetstsi wutoda. Wute xalaala baayzin zigirssin fana geltsoosse baza gelii beezoosse baz ohinttane.
Yinnii gisho, nu morkkuntsi nuulla afa ohinttize iita baz denggaame fana na7atits maaqqide azinii baayzuntsi azinii gelii, na7a yelii, fa keetsito ahode fana zorane.
Hyannippa zaga eertsi azinii baayzuntsi Xalahe kaallodes suub maaqqida.

Fettii ammanze maachita kara asunts gidda azinii baayzanna yeziko iza unttana maaddodes beezane. Yinnii gaar oochchiko, woosa keetsis toofo foollane. Ye wode woosa keetsita maade beezize turii azinii baayzuntsana maaddodes dandda7ine.
Woosa keetstsi loytsii yenggize cimuntsi, ubbappa aatsii, qaala sabbakera tamaarssera labbizuntsi dakko bonchcho ekkodes beezane.
Geeshi maxaafe, «Qoyda baha yedhdhize boora doona accife» Yinnii fana, «Oochchize fa damooze ekkodes beezane»yagayda.
Lam77i woy hyaydzdzii markka baayzin, woosa keetstsi cima mootizebaz si7ippe.
Melluntsi zhashtode fana nagara oochchize oonan as ubba tiino seero.
Neenii as sino bi7ikaayzara, fetaya fetayppa dummuzikaayzara hyanna kiitto naagode fana Xoozze, Laatstse Yesuusa Kiristtoosan doorinttide kiitanchchuntsi tiino ta nena zorane.
Oodellan afa ne kushito gaddii shuumodes ellisippe. Mellunts nagara gelippe; nena geeshshatitsara naago.
Neenii ubba wode hyargginttize gishon ne saza hyarggiti gisho hyaatsi xalaala uzhippe; eeratsi woyne uzho.
Fettii fettii asuntsi nagartta qoncce; bagguntsi nagartta unttana firddodes unttappa tiinii erinttane, yezin melluntsi nagartta suubappa gam7i qonccane.
Yinnii gaar, lo77o oochan qoncce; qonccanxi ixxikon genggodes dandda7oos.
